# Your AI, _your rules._

Assemble is your control center for Voice, Chat, and Employee AI. Make your changes, test in UAT, deploy, and measure, all on your timeline.

[Book a demo](https://interface.ai/talk-to-us)

## Teach, test, take live, _track._

Assemble: the control center

Manage all your interface.ai solutions from the Assemble console. Configure and adjust as it suits you. No code, no tickets.

![](https://interface.ai/product/assemble-facts.webp)![](https://interface.ai/product/assemble-tests.webp)![](https://interface.ai/product/assemble-review.webp)![](https://interface.ai/product/assemble-voice-analytics.webp)

### Teach

Point it at your docs, website, SharePoint to learn. It flags conflicts and cites the source. Nothing goes live until you approve.

### Test

Run every change in UAT first. Test Studio checks real answers against real questions before a member ever sees them.

### Take live

Every change moves through review and approval, with a full audit trail. Versions roll back to a known-good state, with zero downtime.

### Track

Track what matters with built-in Analytics scored on every interaction, and measure outcomes to prove ROI, not just report it.

Prebuilt integrations with your core systems

## One change, _every channel._

Update a policy once, and it’s correct everywhere: same knowledge, same answer, same audit trail, on every channel.

## Skip _the ticket._

Configure assistants, routing, and knowledge yourself. No tickets, no code, no waiting on engineering. Security and audit remain intact.

Assemble: the control center

## Run your AI yourself,  _safely._

PreviousNext

- ### Full audit trail



Every change moves through review and approval, logged end to end in a 7-year immutable audit trail, isolated per tenant.

- ### Version history & rollback



Archive versions and switch back to a known-good state. Production and non-production stay cleanly separate.
